role: descriptive, NON-GATING forensics of the scoreable run-readings (official PASS + FAIL_VALIDATION) of the frozen P5-N2 v1 vacuum campaign; never an input to admission, a verdict, a criterion or a model change

official_outcome_unchanged.statement: the v1 outcome is final and permanent (never rewritten); this analysis reads official statuses and reasons and changes none

evidence_classes.official statuses, reasons, member and c: official frozen scorer output, read (not recomputed)
evidence_classes.dI_rel: model-derived residual (HallThruster.jl window-mean I_d, pinned bfb3019) against a level-3 reconstructed target (Brabston 2025 Table 2 P_d/V_d with the Eq. 14 correction, frozen audit)
evidence_classes.dT_mN: model-derived (T_1D x axial factor, the factor being paper-reconstructed + digitized, readings A/B) minus a level-3 reconstructed (N1) or digitized + reconstructed (N2, N3) corrected thrust
evidence_classes.I_d time statistics, T_e max, ion curren: model-derived (bridge outputs in the frozen raw dataset; the ion current is taken at the downstream domain boundary)
evidence_classes.transport parameters a, b, c, w: assumed model form (EVIDENCE.md level 7) with screening parameters (transport_ensemble_v0.json screening_candidates)
evidence_classes.Xe screening metrics: model-derived in-sample residuals of the P5-Xe identification grid, as recorded in transport_ensemble_v0.json evidence_basis

tolerances_for_context_only.source: prereg/p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json D3 (shown for context; never re-applied here)

s1_coverage.unit: run-reading (one run under one divergence reading), as in the official report; 1080 runs x 2 = 2160

grid_legend.C/T/S: FAIL_VALIDATION with official reasons CURRENT / THRUST / SUSTAINMENT

s2_residuals.unit_note: dI_rel = (I_d,window mean - I_target)/I_target (reading-independent); dT_mN = T_1D x f_reading - T_target (N1-N3 only; D2: thrust at N4/N5 not scored). Scoreable subset only. Distributions split by official status are given per reading because the PASS/FAIL split of a run can differ between readings (THRUST only).

sign_patterns.current_failures_unit: runs (CURRENT is reading-independent; each run counted once)

s3_transport_parameter_relations.caveat: n = 9 candidates, descriptive rank correlation only: not a fit, no significance test, no parameter recommendation. The 9 candidates were selected by the Xe screen (not a designed experiment), so parameters co-vary (see parameter_intercorrelation) and a rank relation cannot be attributed to a single parameter.
s3_transport_parameter_relations.parameter_definition: HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 ScaledGaussianBohm (pinned source, collisions/anomalous.jl docstring; docs/HISTORY.md 2026-09-25): inverse Hall parameter a*(1 - b*exp(-0.5*((z - c*L)/(w*L))^2)); a = anom_scale, b = barrier_scale (trough depth), c = center_L, w = width_L. Derived (post hoc, descriptive): trough floor a*(1-b), trough deficit b*w (Gaussian deficit integral / (a L sqrt(2 pi))).

a_anom_scale.note: constant across all 9 candidates: no rank relation can be formed

s4_member_coverage.label: coverage description, not a verdict, not a promotion; the official verdicts are final
s4_member_coverage.definition: per (candidate, global layer-1 member = registration|coil|reading): the member's 20 official run statuses (4 mandatory chemistries x 5 points); counts of scoreable, PASS and FAIL_VALIDATION; which points and chemistries have at least one scoreable run; whether every scoreable run-reading is PASS (null when none is scoreable). The official member verdict is copied from the scores file.

s5_sustainment_collapse.unit: runs (the official SUSTAINMENT reason is reading-independent; checked on every scoreable run)

Id_field_definitions.dI_rel: window-mean (1-2 ms) I_d residual vs the Eq. 14 target (official scores file)
Id_field_definitions.final10_mean_over_target / final10_frac_: O1 quantities over the final 10 % of the simulated time (official scores file)
Id_field_definitions.Id_rms_rel, Id_pp_rel, Id_max_over_targe: bridge statistics of I_d(t) over the 1-2 ms averaging window (raw dataset)
Id_field_definitions.Te_max_eV: maximum over z of the time-averaged (1-2 ms) T_e profile (raw dataset)
Id_field_definitions.ion_over_discharge: time-averaged (1-2 ms) ion current at the downstream domain boundary / window-mean I_d (raw dataset; bridge_lib.jl uses HallThruster.jl ion_current = ji[end] * channel_area[end], pinned v0.23.1 src/simulation/postprocess.jl); a value > 1 means the model's time-averaged boundary ion current exceeds its window-mean I_d, so an I_i + I_e split with I_e >= 0 is not clean for that run (section 6 caveat)

s6_evidence_statements.phrasing: evidence statements only (what the scoreable subset shows / does not show / does not test); no ranking, no recommendation, no admission, no re-scoring

statements: Coverage: 366/1080 (34 %) runs are scoreable (L32-anode 131/360, L32-exit 8/360, L38-hist 227/360).

PASS evidence: 32 of 732 scoreable run-readings are official PASS, at N1, N3, N4, N5 only. They do not make up any complete member (20 of 20), and the official member verdicts are unchanged. At N2-N5, 28 of 668 scoreable run-readings are PASS; only 668 of the 1728 N2-N5 run-readings are scoreable at all (coverage description, not a verdict; the official verdicts are final).
Official failure reasons by registration (run-readings, CURRENT/THRUST/SUSTAINMENT): L32-anode 226/102/64, L32-exit 12/12/0, L38-hist 314/194/196.

Current level: official CURRENT failures by point, as over/under-predicting runs: N1 12/17, N2 50/1, N3 53/3, N4 64/4, N5 67/5. Median scoreable dI: N1 -0.269, N2 +0.388, N3 +0.287, N4 +0.276, N5 +0.300.

Current at N2-N5 (runs; the CURRENT reason does not depend on the reading): 247 of 334 scoreable runs fail CURRENT (234 over- and 13 under-predicting I_d); 87 are within the current tolerance (no CURRENT reason). The within-tolerance runs are at (runs; points; of which SUSTAINMENT, THRUST A/B, PASS A/B): 01 L38-hist|1p6kW 8 (N3,N4; S 0, T 0/4, P 8/4); 04 L38-hist|3p0kW 4 (N2; S 4, T 4/0, P 0/0); 05 L38-hist|1p6kW 12 (N3,N4,N5; S 12, T 4/4, P 0/0); 05 L38-hist|3p0kW 12 (N3,N4,N5; S 12, T 4/2, P 0/0); 06 L32-anode|1p6kW 12 (N3,N4,N5; S 12, T 0/4, P 0/0); 07 L38-hist|1p6kW 11 (N3,N4,N5; S 11, T 0/3, P 0/0); 07 L38-hist|3p0kW 12 (N3,N4,N5; S 12, T 0/4, P 0/0); 08 L32-anode|1p6kW 1 (N5; S 0, T 0/0, P 1/1); 08 L32-anode|3p0kW 4 (N4,N5; S 0, T 0/0, P 4/4); 08 L38-hist|1p6kW 1 (N5; S 0, T 0/0, P 1/1); 09 L32-exit|1p6kW 2 (N4,N5; S 0, T 0/0, P 2/2); 09 L38-hist|1p6kW 8 (N3,N4,N5; S 8, T 0/1, P 0/0).

By registration|coil (scoreable N2-N5 runs: CURRENT over / CURRENT under / within tolerance): L32-anode|1p6kW 56: 43/0/13, L32-anode|3p0kW 66: 62/0/4, L32-exit|1p6kW 2: 0/0/2, L32-exit|3p0kW 1: 1/0/0, L38-hist|1p6kW 101: 58/3/40, L38-hist|3p0kW 108: 70/10/28.

Restricted to where CURRENT fails: under L32-exit|3p0kW, every scoreable N2-N5 run of the ScaledGaussianBohm screening set fails CURRENT by over-predicting I_d; there the scoreable evidence does not support the modelled current level. This statement does not extend to the other registration|coil combinations.

Under L32-anode|1p6kW, L32-anode|3p0kW, L38-hist|1p6kW, L38-hist|3p0kW, CURRENT fails in some scoreable N2-N5 runs of the ScaledGaussianBohm screening set and not in others (counts above); no current-level statement is made for these combinations as a whole.

Under L32-exit|1p6kW, no scoreable N2-N5 run of the ScaledGaussianBohm screening set carries the CURRENT reason: the modelled current level is within the pre-registered tolerance there (other official reasons, listed above, still apply; coverage description, not a verdict).

Sustainment: 130 of 366 scoreable runs carry the official SUSTAINMENT reason (late collapse), at N1, N2, N3, N4, N5. In these runs the modelled discharge is not sustained to the end of the 2 ms record, while sustainment is a pre-registered observable at N1-N5 (D1).
Thrust follows current: in runs that fail both CURRENT and THRUST, the residual signs agree in 136/136 (reading A) and 136/136 (reading B).

Model-internal decomposition: take the 246 CURRENT over-prediction runs. The model's time-averaged ion current at the downstream domain boundary alone is 1.06-1.66 x I_target (median 1.27). It exceeds I_target in 246 runs and 1.15 x I_target in 198. The ion current carries a median 0.62 (range 0.30-1.10) of the modelled excess I_d - I_target. Conditional inference, not a measured finding: if the current balance I_d = I_i + I_e with I_e >= 0 holds (assumed; verify for the P5 data reduction) and the level-3 reconstructed Eq. 14 target is taken as I_d, then a modelled ion current above I_target would exceed every ion current compatible with that target. No measured ion/electron split at N1-N5 is in the repository's audit, so neither condition is checked against data here.

Caveat on that decomposition: in 1 of 366 scoreable runs of the ScaledGaussianBohm screening set the model's own time-averaged boundary ion current exceeds its window-mean I_d (ion_over_discharge up to 1.018), and in 1 of the 246 over-prediction runs the ion share of the excess exceeds 1. In those runs the model output itself implies a negative time-averaged electron current at the boundary, so the I_e >= 0 decomposition is not clean there (model-derived; the cause is not diagnosed here, verify).

PASS runs, same decomposition: in the 18 distinct PASS runs the modelled boundary ion current is 0.85-1.04 x I_target (median 1.02), above I_target in 13. Agreement of I_d within tolerance does not by itself show that the ion and electron current components agree; neither component is measured.

Model current composition: across the scoreable runs, the time-averaged boundary ion current is 0.822-1.018 of the window-mean I_d (median 0.895). In the CURRENT over-prediction runs it is 0.88-1.50 x the N2-equivalent flow current e*mdot_anode/m_N2 (median 1.08). The reconstructed target I_d (Eq. 14 corrected, level 3) is 0.75-0.90 x that current (mdot_anode measured, Brabston 2025 Table 2). Inferred from mass conservation (time average, steady anode throughput; one N2 molecule yields at most one singly charged N2+): a modelled ion current above 1 x e*mdot_anode/m_N2 requires dissociation or multiple ionisation in the model.

Thrust per ampere: take the ratio (T_axial/I_d)_model / (T_corr/I_d,corr)_target in the non-collapsed scoreable runs at N1-N3 (targets: the frozen measurement audit). Its median is 0.922 under reading A (range 0.802-1.145) and 0.999 under reading B (range 0.893-1.157). The median |1 - ratio| is 0.089 (A) and 0.039 (B). Over the same run-readings the median |dI| is 0.452 (A) and 0.452 (B). In the scoreable subset the thrust residual therefore mostly tracks the current residual; the per-ampere mismatch is smaller than the current mismatch.

cross_candidate: Xe-to-N2 ordering (n = 9 candidates, descriptive rank correlation only): across the 9 candidates, the rank order of the N2 scoreable median dI follows the rank order of the recorded Xe in-sample dI (Spearman rho +0.90 with Xe2, +0.95 with Xe3). The recorded Xe2 dI is negative for 9 of 9 candidates. The N2 scoreable median dI at N2-N5 is positive for 8 of 9. So the between-candidate ordering carries over from Xe to N2 while the level moves from under- to over-prediction. The N2 ordering is therefore not independent of the Xe screening ordering.

Transport parameters (same caveat): the N2 scoreable median dI has rank correlation -0.11 with b, +0.03 with c and -0.64 with w. With the derived trough deficit b*w (chosen post hoc, descriptive) it is -0.89, and b*w also ranks with the Xe in-sample max abs dI (+0.86). In the model form c(z) = a (1 - b exp(-((z - c L)/(w L))^2 / 2)) (HallThruster.jl ScaledGaussianBohm as wrapped in hallthruster_bridge/bridge_lib.jl; docs/HISTORY.md), a larger b or w lowers the anomalous coefficient c(z) over a wider region. That this lowers the modelled current is an inferred model response (evidence class: inferred; not independently sourced, verify); the n = 9 rank correlation is consistent with it but does not demonstrate it. This describes how the model responds. It is not evidence that any parameter value is physically correct, and because the parameters co-vary it cannot be attributed to b*w alone.
a = 0.0625 (1/16) for every candidate, so the scoreable subset carries no information on the anomalous-transport scale a itself.
